ci_support_linux_64_python3.10.____cpyth:
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '15'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
numpy:
- '2'
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.10.* *_cpython
target_platform:
- linux-64
name: ta-lib
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.7.1"

package:
  name: ta-lib
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/TA-Lib/ta-lib-python/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: 732decec9f46f666f36ac55a9d46099bf8ac367dd6ae21cc376d7f4dcea156ed
    patches:
      # remove unnecessary dependencies
      # https://github.com/TA-Lib/ta-lib-python/pull/756
      - patches/dependencies.patch

build:
  number: 0
  script:
    - if: unix
      then:
        - export TA_LIBRARY_PATH=$PREFIX/lib
        - export TA_INCLUDE_PATH=$PREFIX/include
        - export PKG_CONFIG_PATH=$PREFIX/lib/pkgconfig
      else:
        # On Windows, TA-Lib C sources include headers as "ta-lib/ta_defs.h".
        # The libta-lib package installs headers flat under Library/include.
        # Create a transient include subtree with ta-lib\*.h to satisfy includes.
        - if not exist "%SRC_DIR%\include\ta-lib" mkdir "%SRC_DIR%\include\ta-lib"
        - copy /Y "%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\include\ta_*.h" "%SRC_DIR%\include\ta-lib\"
        - set "TA_INCLUDE_PATH=%SRC_DIR%\include;%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\include"
        - set "TA_LIBRARY_PATH=%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib"
        # Also help MSVC find headers/libs via standard INCLUDE/LIB search paths.
        - set "INCLUDE=%SRC_DIR%\include;%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\include;%INCLUDE%"
        - set "LIB=%LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib;%LIB%"
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cython
        - numpy
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - pkg-config
    - libta-lib >=0.6.4
  host:
    - cython
    - libta-lib >=0.6.4
    - numpy
    - pip
    - python
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python
    - numpy

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - talib
      pip_check: true
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pytest
        - pandas
        - polars
    files:
      source:
        - tests/
    script:
      # the test requires exact version match, which seems unnecessary
      - pytest --deselect tests/test_func.py::test_talib_version

about:
  summary: Python wrapper for TA-Lib
  license: BSD-2-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/ta-lib/ta-lib-python

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - sanurielf
    - gerrymanoim
    - llllllllll
    - richafrank
    - mgorny
